chunks: What the Shaykh, may Allah support him, informed me of, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, who said:

I asked him about madhy that comes onto a garment, and he said: "He sprinkles it with water, if he wishes." And he said regarding maniyy that comes onto a garment: "If you know its place, then wash it; and if it is hidden from you, then wash the whole of it."

key_terms.الثَّوْبَ: the garment or clothing affected by impurity
key_terms.الْمَذْيِ: pre-seminal fluid mentioned here in relation to clothing
key_terms.الْمَنِيِّ: semen, requiring washing from the garment
key_terms.بِالْمَاءِ: with water, used here for purification
key_terms.كُلَّهُ: all of it, meaning the entire garment when the place is unknown
key_terms.مَكَانَهُ: its location on the garment, if identifiable

ai.seo_question: What should be done if madhy or maniyy gets on a garment according to the hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on how to purify clothing affected by bodily fluids. It distinguishes between madhy, for which sprinkling water is mentioned, and maniyy, for which washing is required, either at the known spot or over the whole garment if the place is unknown.
